footer.tagline: Ukuhumusha amaphupho nge-AI, mahhala — ngokwendabuko ka-Ibn Sirin kanye nembali yengqondo yesimanje.

home.heroLede: Isithombe esidala, sayensi yengqondo yesimanje ne-AI — kuhlanganiswe ekufundweni okukodwa okucacile. Chaza iphupho lakho ngamagama akho uthole ukuhumusha okususelwa ku-Ibn Sirin nasemoyeni okujulile.
